# The fixture template "tangle"'s branches, in the order they are made, as
# acme's: each line a branch and the branch it starts from, the first the
# root, a branch's files the folder of its name beside this file laid over
# what it starts from; a branch with no folder adds no file
# (features/new.feature, slice-3's scenarios). executables.txt lists the
# files every branch records as executable.
